title: Texans owner Cal McNair: We're fully committed to C.J. Stroud, will see how contract works out

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Texans owner Cal McNair: We're fully committed to C.J. Stroud, will see how contract works out
sources.description: The Texans didn't waste much time after defensive end Will Anderson became eligible for a contract extension before signing him to a new deal that ties him to the franchise through the 2030 season.
